method: Three fresh independent model-blind AI reviewers, each judging 80 deterministically shuffled cases from packets containing only id, scenario, left and right. No author key, generator, category, split, thresholds or predictions were supplied. Single reviewer per case; not expert-human adjudication or field labels. Confidence is subjective and uncalibrated.
